subject.title: Normal tool text outputs can degrade to “(see attached image)” placeholders in agent context

question: Should saturated prompt recovery prioritize the current fresh non-trailing tool result over older frozen projected tool-result history when both cannot fit in the aggregate budget?
rationale: The remaining open fix appears focused, but it intentionally changes which session context survives under aggregate pressure, so maintainers should accept that tradeoff before closing the canonical issue.

options.title: Accept fresh-output priority
options.body: Land the focused projection fix so the model can inspect the latest tool result even if older projected history is reduced first.

options.title: Require installed-session proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, or Telegram saturated-session run proves the non-trailing fresh-result shape outside helper tests.

options.title: Narrow the canonical tracker
options.body: Close this broad issue only after opening or confirming a narrower issue for any remaining empty-output or compaction-diagnostic behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept fresh-output priority
recommendation.body: Land the focused projection fix so the model can inspect the latest tool result even if older projected history is reduced first.
